specs.name: maxOfList_two_first_larger
specs.stmt:
∀ (x y : Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond [x, y]),
    x = y → maxOfList [x, y] h_precond = x

specs.name: maxOfList_two_second_larger
specs.stmt:
∀ (x y : Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond [x, y]),
    y = x → maxOfList [x, y] h_precond = y

specs.name: maxOfList_mem
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    maxOfList lst h_precond ∈ lst

specs.name: maxOfList_upper_bound
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    ∀ x ∈ lst, x = maxOfList lst h_precond

specs.name: maxOfList_cons
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Nat) (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond (x :: xs))
    (h_precond_xs : maxOfList_precond xs),
    maxOfList (x :: xs) h_precond = max x (maxOfList xs h_precond_xs)

specs.name: maxOfList_ge_head
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Nat) (xs : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond (x :: xs)),
    maxOfList (x :: xs) h_precond = x

specs.name: maxOfList_eq_list_maximum
specs.stmt: theorem maxOfList_eq_list_maximum : ∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst), (lst.maximum? = some (maxOfList lst h_precond))

specs.name: maxOfList_idempotent_singleton
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst),
    let r := maxOfList lst h_precond
    maxOfList [r] (by simp [maxOfList_precond]) = r

specs.name: maxOfList_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Nat) (h : maxOfList_precond lst),
    maxOfList_postcond lst (maxOfList lst h) h

specs.name: maxOfList_eq_list_maximum
specs.stmt: ∀ (lst : List Nat) (h_precond : maxOfList_precond lst), maxOfList lst h_precond ∈ lst ∧ ∀ x ∈ lst, x ≤ maxOfList lst h_precond
